Current RTL:
module counter_01 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input up,
  input down,
  output [7:0] count
);
  reg [7:0] count_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      count_reg <= 8'h00;
    end else begin
      if (up && !down) begin
        count_reg <= (count_reg == 8'hFF) ? 8'hFF : count_reg + 1;
      end else if (!up && down) begin
        count_reg <= (count_reg == 8'h00) ? 8'h00 : count_reg - 1;
      end
    end
  end

  assign count = count_reg;
endmodule
